paragraphs: A Mercedes-Benz OM646 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Mercedes already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most OM646 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six OM646-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Mercedes-Benz OM646 engine?
faqLeft.a: The OM646 is Mercedes-Benz's 2.1-litre four-cylinder common-rail diesel engine, in production from 2002 to 2010. It's fitted across four different Mercedes-Benz models — the CLC-Class, E-Class, Viano and Vito.

faqLeft.q: Which Mercedes-Benz models use the OM646?
faqLeft.a: CLC-Class (CLC 200 CDI, CLC 220 CDI), E-Class (E 200 CDI, E 220 CDI), Viano (Viano 2.2 CDI), and Vito (Vito 109 CDI, 111 CDI) — see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the OM646 differ between Mercedes-Benz models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The specific ancillaries, mounting, and vehicle-specific fitment differ by application, even though the base engine code is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is an OM646 from one Mercedes-Benz model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. An OM646 from an E-Class isn't a drop-in match for an OM646 from a Vito — ancillaries, mounting, and fitment all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-Benz OM646 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on OM646 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: What are the common issues with the OM646?
faqRight.a: Injector seal failure ("Black Death") is the most documented issue. Turbocharger issues (oil residue in the air system) and crankshaft position sensor faults (indicating a loose timing chain tensioner) are also documented.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Mercedes-Benz OM646 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Mercedes-Benz if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an OM646 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most OM646 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given how many different OM646 applications exist across the Mercedes-Benz range — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
